caseNameFull: Ickes, Secretary of the Interior v. Fox Ickes, Secretary of the Interior v. Parks and Ickes, Secretary of the Interior v. Eder
attorneys: Solicitor General Fahy and Mr. J. Kennard Cheadle for petitioner. Messrs. Stephen E. Chaffee and Wm. G. Feely for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied.

Mr. Justice Reel took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.

Reported below: 137 F. 2d 30.
